display_name: Sun 2024 EStG Modality Dataset (official supplement, development-only)
owner: S2.1-C-R1 official CSV conflict quarantine and development import
scope_note: S2.1-C-R1 applies the user's pre-result data-governance decision without altering the immutable 2,833-row raw source or either original label. The one exactly locked conflicting-label group is quarantined as a whole from the 2,831-row main analysis population. This is not a general skip-conflicts rule: absent policy or any source/hash/row/label/count mismatch remains fail-closed. All later baseline, LLM, and Hybrid main experiments must share the same 2,831-row population; the full-source sensitivity variant is preregistered but not run.

synthetic_fixture_adapter.scope: tests/fixtures/sun_modality only; must never be described as the official CSV schema

official_csv_schema.verification_basis: Complete strict UTF-8 csv.reader scan of all bytes from ZipFile.open(EStG_sent_vec.csv), with aggregate-only schema_audit.json.
official_csv_schema.sample_id_source: explicit row_index fallback because no verified unique source-ID column exists
official_csv_schema.strict_position_policy: No heuristic column guessing is permitted. Positions above are the only official adapter configuration. Unresolved metadata columns are retained only as local provenance where needed and are never treated as labels.

official_integer_code_mapping.full_scan_finding: The earlier column-1 hypothesis is false. Column 1 is an integer ordinal candidate with values 0-13, not a 0-3 modality code. No official integer code-to-label mapping exists in this CSV schema.
official_integer_code_mapping.adapter_policy: The generic explicit integer-code adapter remains fail-closed when mapping is null or a code is unknown, but it is not used for EStG_sent_vec.csv.

evidence: references/papers/Michel_2022_Decision_rules.pdf p.5 Table 1: definition 1190, obligation 1274, permission 265, prohibitions 104
references/papers/Sun_2024_Design_time_BPC.pdf p.15 section 5.1.1: four class names, but no positional CSV codebook
official_positional_one_hot_mapping.semantic_sanity_check: A few local-only sentences per inferred class were inspected and were consistent; no sentence was stored in a versioned audit artifact.

locked_groups.exclusion_reason: pre-result quarantine of an exact raw-text duplicate carrying inconsistent source labels; neither source label is selected or rewritten

stable_sample_id.algorithm: blake2b(digest_size=8) over canonical JSON [source_asset_sha256, source_key_type, source_key, normalized_text]
stable_sample_id.explicit_source_id_duplicate_policy: fail_closed before writing records.jsonl or any split
stable_sample_id.row_index_fallback: Allowed only when the caller explicitly omits id_column. The 0-based data-row index is then used as source_key and sample_id_policy.row_index_fallback_used=true is recorded in manifest.json. Empty IDs in a configured id_column never fall back.

split.group_definition: All records with the same normalized_text and the same canonical label form one indivisible group.
split.label_conflict_policy: Default is fail closed. The only exception is conflict_policy=pre_result_conflicting_label_group_quarantine with authorized_locked status and an exact match of source hash, normalized/raw text hashes, row indices, labels, group/record counts, population sizes, and computed post-quarantine distribution. Any other conflict or mismatch fails before output.
split.small_class_handling: With train/dev/test all nonzero and min=1, a class with fewer than 3 normalized-text groups is assigned entirely to train with an explicit warning. A class with exactly 3 or more groups receives at least one group in every active split. Groups, classes, and records are never discarded.

leakage_check.normalize_for_dedup: lowercase + collapse whitespace + strip non-alphanumeric (German umlauts preserved, ASCII-only fallback to bytes).
leakage_check.rejection_action: The group-aware allocator prevents leakage by construction; the post-allocation invariant check still raises IngestionError if an implementation bug produces a collision.

split.deterministic_replay: With the same input, contract, and seed, the importer must produce byte-identical output files and a byte-identical manifest.

overwrite_policy.on_no_overwrite_violation: raise IngestionError listing every output path that already exists

license.rationale: archive.org metadata self-reports licenseurl=null and rights=null (recorded in source_manifest.json local_use_authorization_2026_07_15). User authorization on 2026-07-15 allows local research use only and forbids re-distribution, upload, or commit of the original ZIP/CSV/extracted members.

outputs.membership_hash_algorithm: blake2b(digest_size=32) over the sorted canonical JSON of [(sample_id, label)] pairs of all VALID (non-rejected) records
outputs.manifest_self_hash_policy: manifest.json is not listed in output_files. Its hash belongs in an external run receipt, validation report, or experiment event.

importer.label_adapter_policy: synthetic strict_one_hot remains headered-fixture-only. The official adapter is headerless_positional_strict_one_hot at locked columns 4-7. The explicit integer-code adapter is retained as a fail-closed seam but is not used because the complete official scan proved there is no integer modality column.
importer.library_policy: stdlib only (csv, json, hashlib, zipfile, argparse, dataclasses); no pandas, no scikit-learn, no third-party CSV readers

s2_1_b_r1_definition_of_done_check_2026_.s2_1_b_r1_completed_reason: R1 targeted tests passed 54/54 and the first exact-state full audit passed 840 tests with 22 skips and zero integrity errors. Source-ID fail-closed, normalized-text group split, label-conflict fail-closed, the unique 3-group small-class threshold, independent ZIP SHA-1/SHA-256, deterministic manifest, no manifest self-child/placeholder, and synthetic-vs-official adapter separation are verified. S2.1-C may be dispatched separately but was not entered in this repair.

s2_1_c_definition_of_done_check_2026_07_.blocking_condition: One exact normalized sentence occurs twice with conflicting permission and obligation labels. R1 requires label_conflict fail closed; no records/split/manifest may be written until a human or authoritative source resolves the source-label conflict without guessing.
